hooks.command:
mkdir -p "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/commands"
gcloud storage cp gs://extenda-agent-artifacts/config/platform/settings.json "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/settings.json" 2>/dev/null || true
gcloud storage cp gs://extenda-agent-artifacts/hooks/ensure-pre-commit.sh "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/ensure-pre-commit.sh" 2>/dev/null || true
gcloud storage cp gs://extenda-agent-artifacts/hooks/verify-on-stop.sh "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/verify-on-stop.sh" 2>/dev/null || true
gcloud storage cp gs://extenda-agent-artifacts/hooks/tool-guardian.sh "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/tool-guardian.sh" 2>/dev/null || true
gcloud storage cp gs://extenda-agent-artifacts/hooks/secret-scanner.sh "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/secret-scanner.sh" 2>/dev/null || true
gcloud storage cp gs://extenda-agent-artifacts/hooks/test-guard.sh "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/test-guard.sh" 2>/dev/null || true
chmod +x "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/"*.sh 2>/dev/null || true
tmp=$(mktemp); gcloud storage cat gs://extenda-agent-artifacts/agents/orchestrator/instructions.md 2>/dev/null | awk '/^---$/{c++;if(c==2){p=1;next}}p' > "$tmp"; if [ -s "$tmp" ]; then mv "$tmp" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/CLAUDE.md"; cp "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/CLAUDE.md" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/AGENTS.md"; else rm -f "$tmp"; fi
gcloud storage cp gs://extenda-agent-artifacts/commands/init.md "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/commands/init.md" 2>/dev/null || true
gcloud storage cp gs://extenda-agent-artifacts/config/platform/conventions.md "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.agent/conventions.md" 2>/dev/null || true
[ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/ensure-pre-commit.sh" ] && bash "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/ensure-pre-commit.sh" || true
[ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/verify-on-stop.sh" ] && bash "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/verify-on-stop.sh" --baseline || true
